blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-accessibility-1 (Open sort menu traps Tab and cannot be dismissed with Escape) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.recommendation: WCAG 2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap (and 2.1.1 Keyboard). A keyboard user opens the menu with Enter on "Sort: …", focus moves to the first item, and from then Tab and Shift+Tab (both reported as key "Tab") are cancelled and only cycle through the four items; Escape is not handled. The user cannot leave the menu to reach the product list or the rest of the page without picking a sort option, and nothing tells them so. Stop intercepting Tab (let it close the menu and move on, as the APG menu button pattern does), handle Escape to close the menu and return focus to the button, and close the menu when focus leaves it. A native `<select>` with a `<label>` would give all of this for free.
findings.title: Open sort menu traps Tab and cannot be dismissed with Escape

findings.evidence: <button ref={button} type="button" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded="false" onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}>
findings.recommendation: WCAG 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value. `aria-expanded` is hard-coded to "false", so a screen reader user who activates the button hears "Sort: Newest, menu button, collapsed" while the menu is open, and the state never reflects the popup. Bind it to the state: `aria-expanded={open}`.
findings.title: Menu button always announces aria-expanded="false"
